description: This file contains utility functions for string formatting, specifically converting strings to camelCase and Title Case. It ensures consistent string normalization within a frontend application, especially for naming conventions and display purposes.

methods.name: toCamelCaseName(value)
methods.description: Converts a string to camelCase by handling spaces, underscores, hyphens, and multiple whitespace. Returns original value if not a string.

methods.name: toTitleCaseName(value)
methods.description: Converts a string to Title Case, replacing delimiters, collapsing spaces, and correctly capitalizing words including those with apostrophes.
